name: Elise
title: the Spider Queen

Q.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
Q.description: Human Form: Elise injects neurotoxin, dealing 40/70/100/130/160 plus (4 + 0.03×AP) × 0.01 current Health magic damage.
Q.summary: Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is. Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

W.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
W.description: Human Form: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals @spell.EliseHumanW:TotalDamage@ magic damage.
W.summary: Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target. Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.

E.name: Cocoon / Rappel
E.description: Human Form: Elise fires a cocoon, Stunning and revealing the first enemy hit for 1.6/1.8/2/2.2/2.4 seconds.
E.summary: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed. Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

R.name: Spider Form
R.description: Human Form: Elise transforms into a menacing spider, becoming melee, gaining access to Spider Form Abilities and summons all dormant Spiderlings.
R.summary: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

Passive.name: Spider Queen
Passive.description: Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling. Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.
Passive.summary: Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling. Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Shape-shifting jungler who stuns with human E and bursts with both forms' Qs, ganking early and diving with spider E rappel.
strengths: Strong early ganks with E cocoon
Spider E rappel dodges point-and-click abilities and repositions
weaknesses: Cocoon is a skillshot blocked by minions
profile.curveNote: Ganks once cocoon is available (often level 3).
profile.mobility: spider E rappel, spider W attack speed

P.notes: Spider form attacks deal bonus damage and heal

Q.notes: Human: current-HP magic damage; spider: dash bite

W.notes: Human: exploding spiderling; spider: attack speed

E.notes: Human: cocoon skillshot stun; spider: rappel, untargetable in the air

profile.windowAgainst: After human E (cocoon) is used or missed.
